title: REJECTED: requirements-core.txt is not too thin for setup and rehearsal
method: import-blocker: refused every top-level module outside stdlib + {twilio, apscheduler} and imported the rehearsal path
triggers: import cura.setup.preview under a core-only import allowlist
observed_at_discovery: Not a defect. With a meta_path hook rejecting every non-stdlib module except twilio and apscheduler, 'from cura.setup.preview import preview_lines' imported cleanly, so the trimmed core requirements do cover install -> setup -> rehearse. Investigated because a too-thin core list would make install.sh succeed and 'cura rehearse' then crash.
